topics.label: Introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture topic and outlines the expected learning outcomes.

topics.label: Tumor virology, proto-oncogenes, and transformation assays
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics trace how the study of tumor viruses revealed cellular proto-oncogenes and establish the laboratory assays used to detect transformed cellular phenotypes.

topics.label: Oncogenes, tumor suppressors, and cell cycle regulation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics define the functional classifications of cancer-associated genes and illustrate their regulation of the cell cycle and mutation dynamics through the Rb and p53 pathways.

topics.label: Mechanisms and cellular consequences of genetic instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the distinctions, molecular causes, and cellular outcomes of sequence instability and chromosomal instability arising from defective DNA repair, replication errors, and aberrant mitosis.

topics.label: Multi-step tumor progression and hereditary cancer predisposition
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how sequential mutation accumulation drives tumor progression in sporadic cancers and accelerates malignancy in inherited cancer syndromes.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and recommended reading
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture, offers recommended reading, and previews the next session.
